06.steps:
1. Config interface as WAN zone
2. Choose 'PPPoE' in 'IP Assignment'
3. Check 'Unnumbered interface:' checkbox, and choose 'Create new unnumber interface' in the drop-down list
06.title: GUI: The unnumbered interface can be created via 'Create new unnumber interface' option in WAN PPPoE setting page
06.result: In step3, a new page pop up and can create success

18.steps:
1. Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2. Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2, make sure X1 get connected
3. Go to System->Diagnostic, choose 'Ping', ping the router IP
4. Go to router, ping the PPPoE unnumbered interface IP
18.title: Verify the ping between the router and unnumbered PPPoE interface be successful
18.result: In step3&4, Ping traffic go through success

19.steps:
1. Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2. Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2, enable Management(ping/https/snmp/ssh)
3. Enable SNMP in System->SNMP page
4. WAN host ping PPPoE unnumbereed interface IP and visit X1 IP using Explorer and secureCRT, using MIB to get info
19.title: Management (ping/https/snmp/ssh) from WAN host to PPPoE unnumbered interface should be fine
19.result: In step4, all function work well

23.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface, disable Management(ping/https/snmp/ssh)
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2, disable Management(ping/https/snmp/ssh)
3.PC connect to normal LAN/DMZ interface X2, PC ping X2 IP and visit X2 IP using Explorer and secureCRT, using MIB to get info
4.WAN host ping X2 IP and visit X2 IP using Explorer and secureCRT, using MIB to get info
23.title: After uncheck ping/https/snmp/ssh on the unnumbered interface or PPPoE unnumbered interface, verify it should not be allowed to manage

25.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2
3.Click 'Connect' button
4.Click 'Disconnect' button
25.title: Disconnect/reconnect PPPoE unnumbered interface from GUI,check if work fine
25.result:
In step3, PPPoE can get IP
In step4, PPPoE disconnect

27.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2
3.Shutdown PPPoE server
4.No shut PPPoE server
27.title: Verify PPPoE unnumbered can reconnect when PPPoE server is down and then Up
27.result:
In step3, PPPoE disconnect
In step4, PPPoE get IP

29.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2
3.After X1 get IP, change X1 to another mode(Specify IP address/Obtiain IP address)
29.title: If PPPoE unnumbered interface change from unnumbered mode to another mode(Specify Ip address/Obtiain Ip address), it should can reconnect successfully

30.steps:
1.Config X1 as Specify IP address/Obtiain IP address
2.After X1 get IP, config X2 as unnumbered interface
3.Change X1 to PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2
30.title: If PPPoE unnumbered interface change from other mode(Specify Ip address/Obtiain Ip address) to unnumbered mode, it should can reconnect successfully

32.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2
3.After X1 get the same IP with X2, change X2 IP, check log monitor and packet
32.title: If change ip of unnumbered interface, PPPoE unnumbered should reconnect again and PPPoE ip should be the same with the unnumbered interface
32.result: In step3, X1 IP become the same with the new X2 IP, log and packet show a new PPPoE negotiation

40.steps:
1.Config X2 as unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN X1 as PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumber to X2, make sure X1 get connected
3.Check the auto added NAT polices
4.Change X2 netmask, check the auto added NAT polices
40.title: Verify when the unnumbered interface subnet changed, after PPPoE unnumbered interface reconnected the auto added NAT polices should also get update
40.result:
In step3, the two NAT polices added in case 16
In step4, the two NAT polices update

71.steps:
1.Config LAN unnumbered interface with PC connected, add avaiable DHCP server scope for this interface
2.Config WAN PPPoE unnumbered interface, unnumber to LAN unnumbered interface
3.Ping traffic from LAN PC to Internet website
4.Restart the FW
71.title: Restart the FW, verify PPPoE unnumbered can get connected again and traffic is back
71.result: In step4, PC ping traffic success again

72.steps:
1.Config LAN unnumbered interface
2.Config WAN PPPoE unnumbered interface
3.After WAN PPPoE unnumbered interface connected, download TSR
72.title: Verify in TSR all the information for PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumbered interface are correct
72.result: All info about PPPoE unnumbered interface and unnumbered interface are correct in TSR

73.steps:
1.Config several LAN unnumbered interfaces
2.Config several WAN PPPoE unnumbered interfaces, unnumber to LAN unnumbered interfaces
3.After WAN PPPoE unnumbered interface connected, export prefs
4.Change some unnumbered interface settings and import prefs
5.Factory default DUT, import the prefs
73.title: Prefs exporting/importing test
73.result: In step4&5, after DUT boot up, the settings are the same with the prefs
